_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: marginal risks under treatment for all and none, integrated by fixture.truth() and checked with scipy quad

agreement.claim: both engines report the same standardized risks, contrasts and standard errors
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: at most 5e-9 (glm convergence). harness/causal_examples.test.py rebuilds the stacked sandwich with numerical derivatives (agreeing to 1e-7), and checks the conditional log OR exceeds the marginal one, the crude difference is confounded, and the fixed-covariate SE is smaller.

recovery.claim: the risk difference and log risk ratio are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerances separate the effect from zero (RD 0.146, log RR 0.363). Measured by harness/causal_examples.test.py, running python.py on seeds 0 to 99.
